questions.stem: An image safety policy evaluates four harm categories and rejects any severity of 4 or 6. Which TWO implementation decisions match the image:analyze 2024-09-01 contract? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Request FourSeverityLevels for the image analysis.
Average all categories before applying the rejection threshold.
Use EightSeverityLevels as the documented image output scale.
Treat HTTP success as an approval verdict.
Evaluate the policy against each of the four harm categories.

explanation.whyCorrect: The image contract uses values 0, 2, 4 and 6. Analyze the required categories and apply the application's explicit threshold policy.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: The referenced image contract uses four levels.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Success means the analysis request completed.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: An average does not implement an any-category policy.

questions.stem: A model supports masked image edits. The client must change one area of an existing image. Which TWO inputs are directly relevant to the edit definition? Select TWO answers.

options.text: A same-size PNG mask marking edit areas with transparent pixels.
A JPEG mask with the source dimensions but no transparency.
A mask resized to the requested output dimensions instead of the source dimensions.
A same-size mask whose opaque pixels mark the replacement area.
The source image and a prompt describing the intended change.

explanation.whyCorrect: A supported edit request uses the source, edit instructions and spatial mask. Model-specific controls and input requirements still apply.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: The mask dimensions must match the input image, not an independently selected output size.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: The documented mask is PNG and uses transparent pixels; a JPEG has no alpha channel.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: The documented mask uses fully transparent pixels to designate the editable region.

questions.stem: A team evaluates the video-analysis 2026-06-01-preview contract for fast events and tiny labels. Which TWO limitations belong in its evaluation plan? Select TWO answers.

options.text: OCR retains original source resolution for every sampled frame.
Scene segmentation removes the temporal frame-sampling limit.
About one-frame-per-second sampling can miss brief events.
Every source frame is analyzed, but only key frames are returned.
Resizing to 512 by 512 can lose small or distant details.

explanation.whyCorrect: Evaluate the feature against its temporal and spatial resolution. Do not interpret a missing detection as proof that the original video lacks an event or detail.

whyDistractorsWrong.B: Segmentation provides scene organization; it does not remove the documented sampling limitation.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: The captured contract resizes sampled frames; it does not promise original-resolution OCR.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: The documented limit concerns inspected frames, not just the number of returned thumbnails.

sourceRefs.title: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools video solutions

questions.stem: Mixed-language segments were submitted together for translation. Which TWO changes directly target the documented input problem? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Use the intended source language for each segment.
Separate single-language segments.
Increase the translated response length limit.
Detect one source language and submit the whole mixture unchanged.
Move the unchanged mixture to the document endpoint.

explanation.whyCorrect: Language segmentation and explicit intended source handling target the documented condition. The host should inspect translation quality rather than infer success from detection.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: Output length does not separate source-language spans.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: A detected language does not establish that every span was translated.
whyDistractorsWrong.E: Document translation also has documented mixed-language limitations.

sourceRefs.title: Azure Translator known issues and troubleshooting

questions.stem: A source document exceeds the embedding input limit. Arrange the dependency chain that produces searchable chunk vectors.

options.text: Embed each prepared chunk.
Index the chunk text and its compatible vectors.
Read the document text.
Create chunks within the input limit.

explanation.whyCorrect: Each output is the next operation’s input: document text, bounded chunks, embeddings, then index records.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: The source text supplies the chunking input.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Chunking requires source text and produces embedding inputs.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: Vectors are produced from prepared chunks.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Indexing consumes text and completed vectors.

sourceRefs.title: Integrated vector embedding in Azure AI Search

questions.stem: A configured document analyzer returns a long-running operation. Arrange the dependency chain for sending completed extraction to a RAG pipeline.

options.text: Submit document analysis.
Wait for successful operation completion.
Pass that result to downstream ingestion.
Read the completed structured/Markdown result.

explanation.whyCorrect: A returned operation is not extracted content. Completion is required before results can supply downstream ingestion.

whyDistractorsWrong.B: The operation must finish successfully before consumption.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: Only the successful result supplies the representation.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Downstream work requires the extracted representation.

sourceRefs.title: Azure AI Content Understanding client library for Python - version 1.1.0

questions.stem: Match each speech requirement to the relevant capability. Use each selected choice once; one choice is unused.

options.text: Recognize source speech and obtain target-language text
Adapt recognition to specialist terminology using domain data
Render supplied text as spoken audio

explanation.whyCorrect: Custom Speech adapts recognition, Speech translation produces target-language text, and synthesis renders text as audio.

whyDistractorsWrong.B: Adapt recognition to specialist terminology using domain data: Custom Speech.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: Recognize source speech and obtain target-language text: Speech translation.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Render supplied text as spoken audio: Text-to-speech synthesis.

sourceRefs.title: How to recognize and translate speech

questions.stem: Match each text task to the most targeted Language capability. Use each selected choice once; one choice is unused.

options.text: Locate personal identifiers for redaction
Label organizations and locations using predefined categories
Identify a message language for routing

explanation.whyCorrect: The requested output determines the capability. Sentiment measures emotional tone and is unused here.

whyDistractorsWrong.A: Locate personal identifiers for redaction: PII detection.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Identify a message language for routing: Language detection.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Label organizations and locations using predefined categories: Named entity recognition.
